bug_locations: while q[user] and q[user][0] < t-window: q[user].popleft()
explanation: Two bugs: (1) The window boundary was wrong — the spec uses an open interval (time-window, time], so events at exactly t-window should be excluded. The condition was `< t-window` (keeping events at t-window) but should be `<= t-window` (removing events at t-window). (2) Rejected events were being appended to the queue, consuming capacity. Per the spec, only allowed events should consume capacity, so `q[user].append(t)` must be conditional on `ok`.
